remove-dead-out-global.problem: File-scope std::ofstream out; has no reader or writer anywhere in src/ -- ScoreSpecies.cc declares its own unrelated local out for Species.Txt.
remove-dead-out-global.solution: Delete the dead global. Previously flagged 'leave alone for now' in .claude/plan-class-based-chemistry.md, but that note predates this file's new --threads/MT support, which makes an eventual accidental write to it a real data race rather than a hypothetical one.
remove-dead-out-global.benefits: Deletion test says delete: nothing reads this global, and no seam is being served by keeping it.

core-library-targets.problem: Each of the 7 unit-test targets re-lists its src/*.cc dependencies by hand (RunAccumulatorTest lists 5 files; ReactionCounterTest pulls OutputDir.cc transitively); adding a dependency to one class means editing several targets, and a miss is a link error.
core-library-targets.solution: Introduce a static library (e.g. dnachem_core) with the kernel-free modules (OutputDir, ReactionCounter, PhysicsInteractionCounter, RunAccumulator, ChemistryRegistry, ArgParser) that both sim and the tests link; optionally one object library per cluster. Verify in build-ninja/ (Debug CRT pitfalls).
core-library-targets.benefits: Test wiring shrinks to one line per test; the portable/kernel-free convention is enforced by the build.
core-library-targets.sourceDirection: clean the project code architecture. All files are in src/ and header/ with 30+ files. Let's think about adding subdirectories and also why not rename some files if needed. Idea is to cluster source files for easier maintenance

decouple-cross-cluster-includes.problem: Four edges cross the natural clusters: StackingAction dynamic_casts the physics list only to call IsChemistryEnabled(); DnaChemistryList dynamic_casts DetectorConstruction to reach the DnaChemistryWorld; PhysicsList.hh includes DnaChemistryList.hh; Run.hh includes DetectorConstruction.hh though it only forward-declares it.
decouple-cross-cluster-includes.solution: Drop the unused include, forward-declare DnaChemistryList in PhysicsList.hh, and pass the chemistry-enabled flag / chemistry world through a small interface instead of downcasting where a move exposes a real cycle. Two of the four are Geant4-idiomatic downcasts; changing them is optional.
decouple-cross-cluster-includes.benefits: Cluster dependency direction becomes acyclic (core <- geometry/chemistry/scoring <- actions), so the directory tree tells the truth.
decouple-cross-cluster-includes.sourceDirection: clean the project code architecture. All files are in src/ and header/ with 30+ files. Let's think about adding subdirectories and also why not rename some files if needed. Idea is to cluster source files for easier maintenance

cleanup-and-docs.problem: F-005, F-007, F-008, F-009: stale comments claim IRT is rejected fatally and IRT_syn allowed (SBS is hard-coded; the Debug log prints G4EmParameters' model, manifest lacks the model; CLAUDE.md says Build() runs at /run/initialize but in Serial it runs in SetUserInitialization). ReactionCounter::BinFor takes a global mutex on every reaction in MT. Run::Run/Merge look up the Species scorer by passing a hits-collection ID as a primitive index and dereference an unchecked dynamic_cast. Ad hoc std::cerr/G4cout (DetectorConstruction, TimeStepAction per-event lines incl. a raw pointer) instead of DnaLogger, plus dead code (EventAction helpers, StackingAction::DumpPreChemical, RunAction::fDoseAccumulable, global std::ofstream out). Open questions to raise: Q3 whether BoscoloChem (verbatim PureWater copy) should stay selectable; Q4 whether the manifest 'seed' key should be renamed (configuredSeed) or store engine status (ADR 0005).
cleanup-and-docs.solution: Fix comments and CLAUDE.md, log/record the actual model (SBS). Snapshot bin edges per counter/thread at run start and read lock-free. Look up the Species primitive by name with a G4Exception if missing. Route console output through DnaLogger Debug/Trace and delete dead code. Depends on diagnostic-output-files (same TimeStepAction functions).
cleanup-and-docs.benefits: Docs match behaviour, quieter logs, robust scorer lookup, no lock on the reaction hot path.
